stateSemantics.source-ready: Reviewed source and immutable artifact exist; no runtime claim.
stateSemantics.deployed: Expected immutable artifacts are live; no customer-journey claim.
stateSemantics.accepted: The exact target environment, persona, full journey and verifiable persisted result passed.

journey.action: Open the public reporting application without an account or suite session.
Submit an anonymous report with a unique idempotency key.
journey.persistedResult: Own-database report and outbox commit exist before success is returned.

journey.action: Receive a receipt identifier and retain the locally generated mailbox access secret.
journey.persistedResult: Only a verifier-side protected secret representation and verification metadata are durable.

journey.action: Sign in through suite SSO and open only the authorized organization and product case.
journey.persistedResult: Authorized case view with no existence signal for denied actors.

journey.action: Assign the case, move it to review and write a reporter-visible response plus a separate internal note.
journey.persistedResult: Versioned assignment, state, internal note and reporter-visible response are durable.

journey.action: Open the mailbox, read the staff response without seeing the internal note, and send a reply.
journey.persistedResult: Reporter reply is durably linked to the original case and mailbox session.

journey.action: Read the persisted reporter reply in a subsequent authorized manager view.
journey.persistedResult: The next authorized actor can use the reporter reply for continued case handling.

acceptance: Scratch restore proves report, messages, audit and authorization bindings.
Rollback does not reactivate a stale writer or lose an accepted durable commit.

doesNotProve: recoverability until ES-009 evidence is accepted
